query: Which no-annual-fee card gives a flat cash back rate on everything with no categories to track?
ideal_context: Unlimited Cash Rewards (Bank of America). type: cashback. annual fee: $0. Earns an unlimited 1.5% cash back on all purchases with no bonus categories to manage. Rewards never expire while the account is open.

Chase Freedom Unlimited (Chase). type: cashback. annual fee: $0. Earns 1.5% on all other purchases, plus 5% on travel through Chase Travel, 3% on dining, and 3% at drugstores — so it is not a pure flat-rate card.

query: If I just want to pay down a balance cheaply, which card has the longest intro APR and no penalty APR?
ideal_context: BankAmericard (Bank of America). type: balance transfer. annual fee: $0. Low intro APR for the first 21 billing cycles on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. No penalty APR — paying late won't automatically raise your APR. Earns no rewards.
Chase Freedom Unlimited (Chase). type: cashback. annual fee: $0. 0% intro APR for 15 months on purchases and balance transfers, then a variable APR.

query: I have fair credit and I'm worried about approval. What no-fee card helps build credit?
ideal_context: Capital One Platinum Credit Card. type: credit building. annual fee: $0. credit needed: fair (no credit score required to apply). No foreign transaction fees. Automatic credit line review in as little as 6 months. Earns no rewards.
Travel Rewards (Bank of America). type: travel. annual fee: $0. credit needed: good to excellent.

query: What's a good mid-tier travel card with a $95 annual fee and strong dining and travel points?
ideal_context: Chase Sapphire Preferred (Chase). type: travel. annual fee: $95. Rewards: 5x on Chase Travel, 3x on dining, 2x on all other travel. No foreign transaction fee. Intro offer: 75,000 bonus points after $5,000 in purchases in the first 3 months. $100 Chase Travel hotel credit each anniversary year.

Premium Rewards (Bank of America). type: travel. annual fee: $95. Rewards: 2x travel and dining, 1.5x everything else. Up to $200 in combined annual travel statement credits. No foreign transaction fees.

query: Which card earns the most at U.S. supermarkets and on streaming?

American Express Gold Card. type: dining. annual fee: $325. Rewards: 4x at restaurants worldwide, 4x at U.S. supermarkets (up to $25k/yr, then 1x).

Chase Sapphire Preferred (Chase). type: travel. annual fee: $95. Rewards: 3x on dining, 5x on Chase Travel.
